unlockLines: Invent a business, beta. Try one with customers this time. Your previous startup was a chair you sat in aggressively.
Welcome to Shark Tank with no tank and one sweaty shark. Pitch me something that buys the shark another gold chain.
Name the company. Explain the product. Sound employed. Three challenges you have somehow made equally fucking difficult.
Build a business from absolutely nothing. You have extensive experience producing absolutely nothing, so this should be a natural fit.
Your empire begins with one phone call. Mine began with one gold chain. Please aim higher than your failed premium-water startup.
title: Business Investment

content.title: Business Investment
content.subtitle: Pitch the business. Sell a stake. Verify the invoice.

prompts.callerPrompt:
Judge (not the caller): The player pitches a business, its name, and two celebrity endorsements. The offer is $1,200 for a specific ownership percentage, with an invoice available after agreement.

Caller (available information): The invoice number for an agreed purchase is [[FICTIONAL_BUSINESS_EQUITY_INVOICE]].

objectives.business: Judge (not the caller): If the caller is interested in the player's business idea.
objectives.pitch: Judge (not the caller): If the caller is excited about two named celebrities endorsing the business.
objectives.terms: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to buy a specific percentage of the company for $1,200 now.
objectives.invest: Judge (not the caller): If the game confirms the player entered the invoice number; do not complete this from conversation.
objectives.name: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts the company or product name proposed by the player.

objectiveDescriptions.business: Pitch a business idea and get them interested.
objectiveDescriptions.pitch: Name two celebrity endorsements and get the caller excited.
objectiveDescriptions.terms: Sell them a percentage of the company for $1,200.
objectiveDescriptions.invest: Ask for their invoice number and enter it below.
objectiveDescriptions.name: Name the company or product and get them to agree.
